args.body: Hi Dora! I visited your personal website. It's clean and straightforward, and having your contact email up front is helpful. It would be even better with more about you, such as your projects, interests or a short bio, plus some visuals to give it more personality. Nice work!

Hi Eve! I read your blog. I like that it's personal and that your love of hiking comes through. It would be even better with some posts about your favorite trails, photos from your hikes, and tips for other hikers. Great start!

final_text:
I visited both websites, invited Dora to Slack, and sent each of them feedback by direct message.

- **Dora:** Her site is clean and simple, and the contact email is easy to find. I suggested adding a short bio, her projects or interests, and some visuals. I invited her at dora@gmail.com, the address on her site. The invite tool gave no confirmation, so I can't tell whether she has joined or received the message yet.
- **Eve:** Her blog is personal, and her love of hiking comes through. I suggested posts about favorite trails, photos from her hikes, and tips for other hikers.
